reviewed_by: Claude Code under operator request to fix the live Host-session memory stall
reason: Idle Host session release (#1216) also requires the session's protected group to be empty, so a detached process (nohup, setsid, &) that outlived its command is not killed; an unreadable group keeps the session open.
exclusions: Only test_host_memory_runner.py covers the idle release and its fake runner. The kernel tests in that file need a root runner socket and are skipped in CI; they and a detached setsid check passed locally against nebula-memory-runner@agent. No frontend, native or Playwright changes.
